en.Saved: Saved. Return to the game to use these settings.
en.SaveFailed: Could not save. These settings apply for this session.
en.FixedControls:
Left stick: move
Right stick: turn view
Left grip: run
Right grip: change gravity
Right trigger: pick up / drop / interact using the right-hand ray
A: rotate item clockwise
B: rotate item counterclockwise
Y: hold 1s to recenter height and heading; center sticks first, release Y to rearm
Menu button: system / streaming menu
Meta button: Quest system menu
X: menu (pause / resume)
Test levels: open from the pause menu
Left trigger / stick clicks: no action
Headset controls look.
Menu: point with right hand; right trigger clicks / drags. Click Back to return.
en.TestBuildHint: Test levels are available in the pause menu.
en.LevelPointerHint: Aim with the right controller and click with the right trigger. Use Previous / Next / Back.
en.LevelNotice: Skipping levels may cause unexpected game behavior or progress issues.
en.LevelBusy: Game is loading or saving. Please wait, then try again.
en.LevelStartFailed: Could not start test level. See MGVR log.
en.LevelLoadFailed: Level load failed. Choose another level, or restart and reload your save.

zh-CN.Saved: 已保存，返回游戏后即可使用。
zh-CN.SaveFailed: 保存失败，设置仅在本次游戏中生效。
zh-CN.FixedControls:
左摇杆：移动
右摇杆：转向
左握把：跑步
右握把：切换重力
右扳机：沿右手射线拾取／放下／交互
A：顺时针旋转物体
B：逆时针旋转物体
Y：长按约 1 秒归位；先让摇杆回中，松开 Y 后可再次归位
菜单键：系统菜单
Meta 键：Quest 系统菜单
X：菜单
测试选关：在菜单中打开
左扳机／摇杆按下：无操作
头显：控制视线
菜单：右手瞄准，右扳机点击／拖动；点击“返回”返回上页。
zh-CN.TestBuildHint: 测试功能：在菜单中打开选关。
zh-CN.LevelPointerHint: 右手瞄准，右扳机点击。使用下方按钮翻页或返回。
zh-CN.LevelNotice: 跳关可能导致游戏状态或进度异常。
zh-CN.LevelBusy: 游戏正在加载或保存，请稍后重试。
zh-CN.LevelStartFailed: 无法进入测试关卡，请查看 MGVR 日志。
zh-CN.LevelLoadFailed: 关卡加载失败。请选择其他关卡，或重启游戏后读取存档。
